mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (street_area_id, title, summary, description, cover_file_id, activity_type, start_time, end_time, location, poi_id, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{streetAreaId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{description}, #{coverFileId}, #{activityType}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{location}, #{poiId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET street_area_id=#{streetAreaId}, title=#{title}, summary=#{summary}, description=#{description}, cover_file_id=#{coverFileId}, activity_type=#{activityType}, start_time=#{startTime}, end_time=#{endTime}, location=#{location}, poi_id=#{poiId}, status=#{status}, updated_at=#{updatedAt} WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, street_area_id, title, summary, description, cover_file_id, activity_type, start_time, end_time, location, poi_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM activity WHERE id=#{id}
